body: From m-0075 on, each BewareILive check-in lists: commits landed on main since the last check-in and today, PRs (none: we fast-forward main after the gate and the review), each open game's built and verified percentages with the change since the last check-in, and overall completeness (rows done over applicable rows across the open games; today 114/307 = 37%).
summary: Adopted: every check-in reports commits, PRs, per-game percentage changes and overall completeness
